title: Choose the extension's visual world
question: Keep the assigned projectionist direction, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Projectionist's Cue Ledger
options.lineage: cinema subtitle spotting sheets and projection booth cue marks
options.thesis: Every spoken line travels through one precise optical cue track, with learning detail revealed only where the viewer touches it.
options.viewport: A 360px popup reads as one continuous vertical cue strip: live state and timer at the crown, current Mandarin centered at viewing scale, settings compressed into a hinged drawer, and one transport-grade capture control anchored at the foot.
options.risk: It can feel like production software if the learning language and generous transcript scale are not kept primary.

raised.raise: State colors and labels now obey a strict, repeatable broadcast vocabulary.
Every control and type size snaps crisply at extension scale without ornamental blur.
The primary capture action owns a strong vertical motion axis and oversized timer numerals.
Foreground dialogue, middle-layer learning detail, and background diagnostics separate into unmistakable planes.
Hover becomes a single visible cut edge that opens pronunciation and meaning from the line.
Popup, background capture, and player overlay share one legible state system rather than decorative local variants.

options.label: Annotated Reader's Margin
options.lineage: Chinese interlinear readers, ruby annotation, and editorial marginalia
options.thesis: The moving subtitle becomes a beautifully typeset study edition whose notes appear exactly at the unfamiliar word.
options.viewport: The popup opens like a compact reader page: one large live Mandarin line, pinyin as quiet ruby type, a narrow status margin, and configuration folded below the reading surface.
options.risk: This is the most familiar learner-native direction and can become bookish or precious if motion and capture state lack confidence.

options.label: Teletext Learning Service
options.thesis: Live Mandarin arrives as a direct-address broadcast page: rigid, immediate, and impossible to misread.
options.viewport: A sacred character grid puts LIVE, elapsed time, the current line, and direct controls on one page with no cards or ornamental containers.
options.case: It beats the assigned world on instantaneous state clarity but identifies less naturally with modern Mandarin learners.
options.risk: Without absolute grid discipline it collapses into retro novelty and makes Chinese typography coarse.

options.label: Pixel Arcade
options.thesis: Learning actions become sprite states on a luminous tiled playfield.
options.viewport: A score-like status rail sits above a tile-perfect dialogue playfield and two large input actions.
options.case: The game vocabulary weakens both serious learner identification and subtitle clarity.
options.kept: Crisp integer-like scaling and strict state swaps.
options.risk: Gamifies a viewing tool and compromises the fidelity of Han characters.

options.label: Racing League
options.lineage: anti-aliased racing identities and trackside telemetry
options.thesis: Transcription state pulls left to right as fast telemetry, with the active line wearing the current livery.
options.viewport: An oversized elapsed counter and diagonal transcript lane drive toward a full-width start control.
options.case: It supplies energy but maps poorly to reflective language learning and overstates speed as the product value.
options.kept: Decisive action hierarchy and confident numerical scale.
options.risk: Feels like performance software rather than a companion to a film.

options.label: Park Poster
options.thesis: Each subtitle state occupies a flat visual plane with one ranger-clear imperative.
options.viewport: A scene-like stack places dialogue above one bold caption-bar action.
options.case: The hierarchy is strong, but landscape metaphor does not explain hover learning or live capture.
options.kept: Clear foreground, middle, and background planes.
options.risk: Poster composition turns an operating surface into an illustration.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Hover cuts open a spoken phrase and exposes pronunciation in the blue air behind it.
options.viewport: A Mandarin phrase spans pale blocks; the active word opens a narrow blue reveal while controls sit on a quarry tally strip.
options.case: The reveal metaphor is excellent but atmosphere obscures operating state and demands unsupported visual assets.
options.kept: One unmistakable active edge for intentional disclosure.
options.risk: Visual spectacle competes directly with the video the extension must keep primary.

options.label: Tensegrity Diagram
options.thesis: Each word, gloss, and system state becomes a node held in a visible network of attention.
options.viewport: A sparse node graph connects the live line to capture state and word-level annotations.
options.case: The shared-state logic is rigorous, but the force diagram is too abstract for a frequent compact control surface.
options.kept: One underlying state graph expressed consistently across every surface.
options.risk: Makes familiar controls slower to scan and touch.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished dark browser-extension utility with stacked settings cards and a bright primary button.
canonCard.viewport: A compact header, configuration card, transcript card, and two full-width buttons in the expected order.
canonCard.risk: Immediately usable but intentionally indistinguishable from other developer-facing extension tools.
